packageRules.description: Major bumps are never automated - the drift audit reviews majors by hand (Nextcloud/kps/Traefik/Authentik class)
0.x images stay on their minor stream (0.23.2 -> 0.23.x only; minors in 0.x can break)

customManagers.description: Image tags inside kustomize helmCharts valuesInline, which no built-in manager reads. Opt-in per tag with a `# renovate: datasource=docker depName=<image>` comment on the line directly above `tag:`
